longterm.outlook: Collin Sexton enters this season as a key scoring option off the Lakers’ bench after averaging 15.4 PPG and 3.3 APG in just 23.7 MPG last season. He shot 48.5% from the field and 40.1% from three, including 44.5% on catch-and-shoot attempts. Sexton can create off the dribble, attack the rim and provide secondary playmaking, but a reserve role behind Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves limits his ceiling. He’s a source of points and triples, but is most likely a waiver wire add unless you are in a deeper league.
